prompt: In a vibrant anime style scene set inside a fire station, a firefighter in a yellow helmet stands on the left, holding a coiled hose tightly. Next to him in the center, a dalmatian with black spots sits calmly on the polished floor, looking up attentively. On the right, a mechanic in blue overalls points toward a large red truck parked nearby. A young child in a pink jacket stands beside the mechanic, gazing at the shiny vehicle with wide eyes. Above them, a silver bell hangs from the ceiling, remaining perfectly still. The firefighter in the yellow helmet hands a small badge to the young child in the pink jacket. The dalmatian with black spots rests its head near the boot of the firefighter in the yellow helmet. There is no smoke visible in the air.
